update.versionPolicy: Semantic versioning. Keep every listed version location identical and tag each published version as v<version>.
changeProcedure: Read this file and compare its version with the remote metadata before changing the bundle.
Update the skills, documentation, metadata, and every version location atomically.
Run the plugin validator and bundle tests, then create a conventional commit and annotated v<version> tag.
Push the commit and tag, then verify them from a fresh clone.
